name: linear-combinations
description:
Every combination of one item from each column of the table, one column per list (the Cartesian product).

The first column changes slowest: купить, заказать × диван, стол → купить диван, купить стол, заказать диван… The first column of the result, phrase, holds each combination as one phrase: its items joined by one space, in the column order; the columns of the lists follow it. The empty cells of a column are skipped, so the lists may differ in length; a column with no items is refused, and so is a column named phrase.
limit: the most rows the result may hold; a larger result is refused before any is made.

Example: semkit read combine.csv linear-combinations write -
-> купить диван, купить, диван; купить кресло, купить, кресло; заказать диван, заказать, диван; заказать кресло, заказать, кресло

The step makes a table of its result; it replaces the current table, its first text column is the working one.

options.name: --limit
options.description: the most rows the result may hold; a larger result is refused before any is made.
